title: Management Information Systems, B.S. (Business)
notes: Same real program as BAIS-2022.json and BAIS-2026.json under its pre-2025-26-rename name -- see BAIS-2022.json's notes for the full plan-code/department continuity check (this page's own <meta name="keywords"> tag is again 'MIS_BS, MIS', identical to 2022-23 and to the current live/2026 bulletin). Fetched via raw curl + regex table parse and cross-checked against this page's own printed per-term subtotals (15/14/17/15/15/15/14/15 = 120 total) -- byte-for-byte identical course sequence to BAIS-2022.json's University Park plan, confirmed by direct diff of the parsed tables. The only textual differences from the 2022-23 edition: this page's 'Two-Piece Sequence' cells now carry a footnote-5 marker ('Two-Piece Sequence 5' / 'BA 411 (or Two-Piece Sequence) 5'), but footnote 5 itself still resolves to nothing (no linked course list anywhere on this page, same as 2022-23) -- so still modeled as an honest generic 3cr placeholder slot, not a 'match' regex, same as BAIS-2022.json. Same reconciliation of the 'BA 411 (or Two-Piece Sequence)' Fourth-Year duplicate-text cell as BAIS-2022.json: BA 411 (a real, singly-listed Prescribed Course here) placed once in Fourth Year Fall, with a second generic breadth/Two-Piece slot in Fourth Year Spring so the two generic-breadth slots in this plan sum to exactly 6 credits, matching this page's own Program Requirements line 'Select 6 credits of supporting coursework. See Department List.' Fourth Year Fall's Gen Ed slot is still tagged '(Z)' on this page (same retired 'Linked' inter-domain designator as 2022-23; footnote 4 here still reads '6 credits of Inter-Domain (N) and/or Linked (Z) coursework') -- mapped to this app's 'INTER-D' gen_ed key, same as the '(N)' slots elsewhere. Same real MATH-chain prereq gap as every other BAIS catalog-year file (a property of MATH/SCM/STAT/ACCTG's actual prerequisites, not of this catalog year specifically): added MATH 3 (Semester 1) and MATH 4/MATH 21 (Semester 2) to unlock SCM 200/STAT 200/ACCTG 211, same placement as BAIS-2022.json/BAIS-2025.json/BAIS-2026.json. Bumped max_credits_per_semester from 17 to 18, same as those files, to keep 4-year graduation achievable with the added 9 credits. 'etm' marks this page's own Entrance-to-Major footnote-2 courses.
